## Preamble

This script runs GO Enrichment using `topGo` on our `DESeq2` analysis results. This script is adapted from the Lecture 7.3 script provided by MICB 405 at the University of British Columbia Vancouver (2026W1).

## 1. Load Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(topGO))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

## 2. Generate Gene Universe

```{r}
# Create Mapping Table
geneID2GO <- readMappings("go_term_tables/mesaur_GOIDs.tsv")

# Generate `topGO` Gene Universe
geneUniverse <- names(geneID2GO)

```

## 3. Load Lists of Differentially Expressed Genes

```{r}
# Load raw gene lists
results <-read.csv("genes/Interaction Contrast_ 4dpi vs 80dpi/4dpi_80dpi_int_contrast_complete.csv")
pos_gene <- results %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange >= 1)
neg_gene <- results %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange <= -1)

# Convert/Coerce to characters
pos_gene_names <- as.character(pos_gene$X)
neg_gene_names <- as.character(neg_gene$X)

# Convert to factors
pos_gene_list <- factor(as.integer(geneUniverse %in% pos_gene_names))
neg_gene_list <- factor(as.integer(geneUniverse %in% neg_gene_names))
names(pos_gene_list) <- geneUniverse
names(neg_gene_list) <- geneUniverse
```

## 4. Build topGOdata Objects

```{r}
# positive genes
pos_GO_data <- new("topGOdata",
                  description = "mesaur_interaction_4dpi_vs_80dpi_pos",
                  ontology = "BP",
                  allGenes = pos_gene_list,
                  annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
                  gene2GO = geneID2GO)

# negative genes
neg_GO_data <- new("topGOdata",
                    description = "mesaur_interaction_4dpi_vs_80dpi_neg",
                    ontology = "BP",
                    allGenes = neg_gene_list,
                    annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
                    gene2GO = geneID2GO)

```

## 5. Run Statistical Tests on topGOdata Objects

```{r}
pos_result <- runTest(pos_GO_data,
                     algorithm = "weight01",
                     statistic = "fisher")

neg_result <- runTest(neg_GO_data,
                       algorithm = "weight01",
                       statistic = "fisher")
```

## 6. Extract a summary of positive and negative results

```{r}
pos_GO <- GenTable(pos_GO_data,
                       weight01 = pos_result,
                       orderBy = "weight01",
                       ranksOf = "weight01",
                       topNodes = 50)

neg_GO <- GenTable(neg_GO_data,
                         weight01 = neg_result,
                         orderBy = "weight01",
                         ranksOf = "weight01",
                         topNodes = 50)
```

# 7. Visualizing positive topGO Analyses
 
```{r}
pos_GO_filtered <- pos_GO %>%
  mutate(GeneRatio = Significant/Annotated, 
         weight01 = as.numeric(weight01)) %>%
  filter(weight01 <= 0.05) %>%
  head(n = 20)

pos_GO_filtered_arranged <- pos_GO_filtered %>% 
  arrange(GeneRatio) %>%
  mutate(Term = factor(Term))

order_term <- pos_GO_filtered_arranged %>% 
  pull(Term)

pos_GO_filtered_arranged %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x= Term,y = GeneRatio, colour = weight01)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.05) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Significant)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = order_term) + 
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue")+
  theme_light() +
  labs(x = "GO Term (Biological Process)", 
       y = "Enrichment Ratio", 
       color = "weight01 p-value", 
       size = "Number of Significant Genes", 
       title = "GO enrichment of positive interaction genes for 4 dpi vs 80 dpi") + 
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"), panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), 
                     expand = c(0, 0.05)) 

```

# 8. Visualizing negative topGO Analyses

```{r}
neg_GO_filtered <- neg_GO %>%
  mutate(GeneRatio = Significant/Annotated,

neg_GO_filtered_arranged <- neg_GO_filtered %>%

order_term <- neg_GO_filtered_arranged %>%

neg_GO_filtered_arranged %>%

  geom_col(width = 0.05) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Significant)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = order_term) + 
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue")+
  theme_light() +
  labs(x = "GO Term (Biological Process)", 
       y = "Enrichment Ratio", 
       color = "weight01 p-value", 
       size = "Number of Significant Genes", 
       title = "GO enrichment of negative interaction genes for 4 dpi vs 80 dpi") + 
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"), panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), 
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), 
                     expand = c(0, 0.05)) 

```


## 9. Visualizing positive and negative topGO Analyses

```{r plot-updown, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}
pos_GO <- pos_GO %>% 
  mutate(pos_neg = "POS")

neg_GO <- neg_GO %>% 
  mutate(pos_neg = "NEG")

joined_GO_filtered_arranged <- bind_rows(pos_GO, neg_GO) %>%
  mutate(GeneRatio = Significant/Annotated, weight01 = as.numeric(weight01)) %>%
  filter(weight01 <= 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
  mutate(Term = factor(Term)) %>%
  head(n = 40)

order_term_joined <- joined_GO_filtered_arranged %>% 
  pull(Term)

joined_GO_filtered_arranged %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x= Term, y = GeneRatio, color = weight01)) +
  geom_point(aes(size= Significant)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = order_term_joined) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x = "GO Term Description", 
       y = "Enrichment Ratio", 
       color = "weight01 p-value", 
       size = "Number of Significant Genes", 
       title = "GO enrichment of positive and negative genes interaction for 4dpi vs 80dpi") +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"), 
        panel.grid = element_line(colour = "grey96"), 
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_grid(.~ pos_neg)

```

## 10.Extract Genes Associated with Enriched GO Terms
note: did not run for interaction yet

```{r message=FALSE}

mesaur_GOIDs <- read_tsv("go_term_tables/mesaur_GOIDs.tsv", col_names = c("gene_id", "GO_id"))
glimpse(mesaur_GOIDs)

# choose GO ID from  data set
GO_ID <- neg_GO_filtered_arranged$GO.ID[5]
#OR: GO_ID <- pos_GO_filtered_arranged$GO.ID[]

# Select rows that contain our GO term of interest
filtered_GO_ID <- mesaur_GOIDs %>%
  filter(grepl(pattern = GO_ID, GO_id))
glimpse(filtered_GO_ID)

# Vector of gene IDs to select
gene_id_vector <- filtered_GO_ID %>% 
  pull(gene_id)

# Filter the data set
dat_GO_filtered <- down_gene %>%
  filter(X %in% gene_id_vector) %>%
  filter(padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange <= -1)

glimpse(dat_GO_filtered)

dat_GO_filtered %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = X, y = log2FoldChange)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = log2FoldChange - lfcSE, ymax =log2FoldChange + lfcSE), width = 0.4) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  coord_flip()+ 
  labs(y = "log2(FC)", x= "Gene ID") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"), panel.grid = element_line(colour = "white"))
```
